transcript.text: For the analysis ahead I need you to remember a specific working definition and apply it in later sessions. The 'house tier' is the customer tier that placed the most orders. Please save this definition to memory now and link it to the dataset it concerns.

args.content: Working definition: The 'house tier' is the customer tier that placed the most orders (i.e., the tier value in customers.tier with the highest count of orders, determined by joining orders to customers and counting orders grouped by tier — not a fixed/static tier, but computed from order volume). Use this definition consistently in any analysis referencing the 'house tier' on the orders/customers datasets.
